stem_book: Which statement regarding 2s and 2p radial probability distributions is correct? (a) Both show one radial node (b) 2p has greater probability near the nucleus than 2s (c) 2s has one radial node whereas 2p has no radial node (d) 2s and 2p have identical angular density
key: c 2s has one radial node whereas 2p has no radial node
derived: c 2s has one radial node whereas 2p has no radial node
correct_answer: c 2s has one radial node whereas 2p has no radial node
work: Radial nodes = n − ℓ − 1: 2s = 1, 2p = 0; 2s penetrates more (b false); s spherical vs p lobed (d false)
